SELECT
    a."atom_id",
    bt."bond_type_count"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m
    ON m."molecule_id" = a."molecule_id"
CROSS JOIN (
    
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b."bond_type") AS "bond_type_count"
    FROM "bond" b
    JOIN "molecule" m2
        ON m2."molecule_id" = b."molecule_id"
    WHERE m2."label" = 'TR346'
) bt
WHERE m."label" = 'TR346'
ORDER BY a."atom_id";

SELECT DISTINCT m."molecule_id", m."label"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
JOIN "connected" c ON c."atom_id" = a."atom_id"
JOIN "bond" b ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE a."element" = 's'
  AND b."bond_type" = ' = ';

SELECT a."atom_id", a."molecule_id", a."element"
FROM "atom" a
WHERE a."element" = 'c'
  AND CAST(SUBSTRING(a."molecule_id" FROM 3 FOR 3) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 50;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS "non_carcinogenic_count"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '-'
  AND LOWER(a."element") = 'na';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a."atom_id") AS atom_count
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '+'
  AND LOWER(a."element") = 'h'
  AND m."molecule_id" IN (
      
      SELECT a2."molecule_id"
      FROM "atom" a2
      WHERE LOWER(a2."element") = 'h'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "bond" b ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '#'
  AND m."label" = '-';

SELECT
    m."molecule_id",
    m."label",
    CASE
        WHEN m."label" = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN m."label" = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS "carcinogenicity"
FROM "molecule" AS m
WHERE m."molecule_id" = 'TR000';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '+'
  AND LOWER(a."element") = 'n';

SELECT m."label"
FROM "bond" b
JOIN "molecule" m ON m."molecule_id" = b."molecule_id"
WHERE b."bond_id" = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT
    c."atom_id"  AS first_atom_id,
    c."atom_id2" AS second_atom_id
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON c."bond_id" = b."bond_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."bond_id") AS connection_count
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
WHERE a."atom_id" LIKE 'TR%\_19' ESCAPE '\';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a."atom_id") AS total_atoms
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE a."element" IN ('p', 'br')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "bond" b
    WHERE b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
      AND b."bond_type" = '#'
  );

SELECT
    b."bond_type",
    b."bond_id"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE SUBSTR(c."atom_id", 7, 2)::int = 45

SELECT DISTINCT m."molecule_id"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "bond" b ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '-'
  AND b."bond_type" = '-'
ORDER BY m."molecule_id"
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."molecule_id",
    m."label",
    CASE
        WHEN m."label" = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN m."label" = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS "carcinogenicity"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a
    ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE LOWER(a."element") = 'ca'

SELECT
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN m."label" = '+' AND a."element" = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
    / COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id") AS percentage
FROM "molecule" m
LEFT JOIN "atom" a
    ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"

SELECT DISTINCT b."bond_type"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE (c."atom_id" = 'TR004_8' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c."atom_id" = 'TR004_20' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR004_8');

SELECT b."bond_type"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "bond" b ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
WHERE (c."atom_id" = 'TR000_1' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR000_2')
   OR (c."atom_id" = 'TR000_2' AND c."atom_id2" = 'TR000_1');

SELECT DISTINCT a."atom_id"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
JOIN "connected" c ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
JOIN "bond" b ON c."bond_id" = b."bond_id"
WHERE m."label" = 'TR012'
  AND a."element" = 'c'
  AND b."bond_type" = ' = ';

SELECT m."molecule_id", m."label"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."label" = '-'
GROUP BY m."molecule_id", m."label"
HAVING COUNT(a."atom_id") > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."molecule_id",
    b."bond_type"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "bond" b ON b."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."molecule_id" >= 'TR000'
  AND m."molecule_id" <= 'TR050'
ORDER BY m."molecule_id", b."bond_type";

SELECT
    
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a."element" = 'h' THEN m."molecule_id" END)::numeric
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m."molecule_id"), 0)) * 100.0 AS percentage
FROM "molecule" m

LEFT JOIN "atom" a

SELECT
    m."label",
    SUM(CASE WHEN a."element" = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
        / COUNT(a."atom_id") AS ratio
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "atom" a ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"
WHERE m."molecule_id" = 'TR006'

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"

SELECT DISTINCT a2."element"

SELECT a."element"

SELECT

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"

JOIN "bond" b ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"
FROM "connected" c

UNION


SELECT DISTINCT a."element"
FROM "connected" c

SELECT
    m."molecule_id",
    m."label",
    a."element"

JOIN "atom" a

SELECT a."element"
FROM "atom" a
JOIN "molecule" m ON a."molecule_id" = m."molecule_id"

SELECT

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"

WHERE b."bond_type" = '='

SELECT
    u."creationdate" AS account_creation_date
FROM "users" u
WHERE u."displayname" = 'IrishStat'
ORDER BY u."creationdate" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c."id",
    c."postid",
    c."score",
    c."text",
    c."creationdate",
    c."userid",
    c."userdisplayname"
FROM "comments" AS c
WHERE c."userdisplayname" = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY c."creationdate" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT p."body"
FROM "tags" t
JOIN "posts" p ON p."id" = t."excerptpostid"
WHERE t."tagname" = 'bayesian'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS vote_count
FROM "votes" v
WHERE v."userid" = 58
  AND v."creationdate"::date = DATE '2010-07-19';

SELECT DISTINCT
    u."reputation"
FROM "badges" b
JOIN "users" u
    ON u."id" = b."userid"
WHERE b."date" = TIMESTAMP '2010-07-19 19:39:08'

WITH min_rep AS (
    SELECT MIN("reputation") AS min_reputation
    FROM "users"
),

lowest_users AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "users", min_rep
    WHERE "reputation" = min_rep.min_reputation
)

SELECT DISTINCT b."name"
FROM "badges" b
JOIN lowest_users lu ON b."userid" = lu."id";

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "user_count"
FROM (
    SELECT "userid"
    FROM "badges"
    GROUP BY "userid"
    HAVING COUNT("name") > 5
) AS "b";

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Daniel Vassallo';

SELECT "id"
FROM "users"
ORDER BY "reputation" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    p."viewcount" AS total_views,
    p."lasteditordisplayname" AS last_editor_displayname
FROM "posts" p
WHERE p."title" = 'Computer Game Datasets'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    p.post_count,
    v.vote_count,
    CASE WHEN v.vote_count = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE p.post_count::numeric / v.vote_count
    END AS posts_to_votes_ratio
FROM
    (SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
     FROM "posts"
     WHERE "owneruserid" = 24) p
CROSS JOIN
    (SELECT COUNT(*) AS vote_count
     FROM "votes"
     WHERE "userid" = 24) v;

SELECT DISTINCT
    u."creationdate" AS user_creation_date,
    u."age" AS user_age
FROM "comments" c
JOIN "users" u ON u."id" = c."userid"
WHERE c."text" LIKE '%http://%';

SELECT p."id" AS post_id
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'slashnick'
ORDER BY p."answercount" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c."text" AS comment_text,
    c."userdisplayname" AS user_display_name
FROM "comments" c
JOIN "posts" p ON p."id" = c."postid"
WHERE p."title" = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c."creationdate" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p."id" AS post_id,
    b."name" AS badge_name
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u
    ON u."id" = p."owneruserid"
JOIN "badges" b
    ON b."userid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Samuel'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."creaiondate"::timestamp) = 2013
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b."date"::timestamp) = 2013
GROUP BY p."id", b."name"
ORDER BY p."id", b."name";

SELECT
    
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u."upvotes" = 0 THEN c."userid" END)::numeric
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c."userid"), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "comments" c
LEFT JOIN "users" u
    ON u."id" = c."userid"
WHERE c."score" BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT
    p."favoritecount" AS favorite_count
FROM "comments" AS c
JOIN "posts" AS p
    ON p."id" = c."postid"
WHERE c."userid" = 3025
  AND c."creationdate" = TIMESTAMP '2014-04-23 20:29:39'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p."id") AS post_count
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON u."id" = p."owneruserid"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Matt Parker'
  AND p."id" > 4;

SELECT DISTINCT p."tags"
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Mark Meckes'
  AND p."commentcount" = 0
  AND p."tags" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT u."displayname"
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON p."id" = v."postid"
JOIN users u ON u."id" = v."userid"
WHERE v."bountyamount" = 50
  AND p."title" ILIKE '%variance%';

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp) AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "badges"
    WHERE "name" = 'Student'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp) IN (2010, 2011)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp)
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
    FROM "badges"
    WHERE "name" = 'Student'
)
SELECT
    
    (
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yc.year = 2010 THEN yc.cnt END), 0)::numeric
        / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0) * 100
        -
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yc.year = 2011 THEN yc.cnt END), 0)::numeric
        / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0) * 100
    ) AS percentage_difference
FROM yearly_counts yc
CROSS JOIN total t
GROUP BY t.total_cnt;

SELECT
    p."ownerdisplayname" AS "displayname",
    SUM(p."viewcount") AS "total_viewcount"
FROM "posts" p
WHERE p."ownerdisplayname" IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY p."ownerdisplayname"
ORDER BY "total_viewcount" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(p."tags") LIKE '%<r>%' THEN p."id" END)::numeric
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p."id"), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u
    ON u."id" = p."owneruserid"
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Community';

WITH most_influential AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "users"
    ORDER BY "reputation" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),

stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(p."id") AS total_posts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p."score" > 50 THEN 1 END) AS posts_above_50
    FROM "posts" p
    JOIN most_influential mi ON p."owneruserid" = mi."id"
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN total_posts = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (posts_above_50::numeric / total_posts) * 100
    END AS percentage
FROM stats;

SELECT DISTINCT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
WHERE ha."attribute_value" BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT
    s."full_name"
FROM "superhero" AS s
JOIN "hero_power" AS hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
GROUP BY s."id", s."full_name"
HAVING COUNT(hp."power_id") > 15;

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
WHERE a."alignment" = 'Neutral';

SELECT c."colour"
FROM "superhero" AS s
JOIN "colour" AS c ON s."skin_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" = 'Apocalypse';

SELECT sp."power_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
WHERE s."full_name" = 'Hunter Zolomon'

SELECT sp."power_name"
FROM "superhero" AS sh
JOIN "hero_power" AS hp ON hp."hero_id" = sh."id"
JOIN "superpower" AS sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
WHERE sh."superhero_name" = 'Abomination';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."id") AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "attribute" a ON a."id" = ha."attribute_id"
WHERE a."attribute_name" = 'Speed'
  AND ha."attribute_value" = 100;

SELECT r."race"
FROM "superhero" AS s
JOIN "race" AS r ON r."id" = s."race_id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" = 'Copycat';

SELECT
    sh."superhero_name",
    sh."height_cm"
FROM "superhero" sh
JOIN "colour" c ON sh."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE LOWER(c."colour") = LOWER('Amber');

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "attribute" a ON a."id" = ha."attribute_id"
WHERE a."attribute_name" = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha."attribute_value" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c."colour"
FROM "superhero" AS s
JOIN "colour" AS c ON s."skin_colour_id" = c."id"
JOIN "hero_attribute" AS ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
WHERE ha."attribute_value" = 100;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."id") AS hero_count
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
WHERE c."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND sp."power_name" = 'Agility';

SELECT
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
    /
    
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric
    AS ratio
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id";

SELECT
    s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" AS s
JOIN "colour" AS eye_c
    ON eye_c."id" = s."eye_colour_id"
JOIN "colour" AS hair_c
    ON hair_c."id" = s."hair_colour_id"
WHERE eye_c."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND hair_c."colour" = 'Brown';

SELECT
    s."superhero_name",
    s."height_cm",
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s."height_cm" DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rank"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s."height_cm" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."height_cm" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_attribute" ha ON ha."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "attribute" a ON a."id" = ha."attribute_id"
WHERE a."attribute_name" = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha."attribute_value" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT g."gender"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
WHERE sp."power_name" = 'Phoenix Force';

WITH avg_height AS (
    SELECT AVG("height_cm") AS avg_h
    FROM "superhero"
    WHERE "height_cm" IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT DISTINCT sp."power_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "hero_power" hp ON hp."hero_id" = s."id"
JOIN "superpower" sp ON sp."id" = hp."power_id"
CROSS JOIN avg_height ah
WHERE s."height_cm" IS NOT NULL
  AND s."height_cm" > ah.avg_h * 0.8;

SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN "full_name" = 'Emil Blonsky' THEN "weight_kg" END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN "full_name" = 'Charles Chandler' THEN "weight_kg" END) AS weight_difference
FROM "superhero"
WHERE "full_name" IN ('Emil Blonsky', 'Charles Chandler');

SELECT DISTINCT
    p."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero" AS s
JOIN "publisher" AS p
    ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE s."superhero_name" IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy');

SELECT AVG(sh."height_cm") AS average_height
FROM "superhero" sh
JOIN "publisher" p ON sh."publisher_id" = p."id"
JOIN "race" r ON sh."race_id" = r."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics'
  AND r."race" <> 'Human';

SELECT
    
    (SUM(CASE WHEN g."id" = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(a."id")::numeric) * 100.0 AS female_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "alignment" a ON a."id" = s."alignment_id"
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
WHERE a."id" = 2;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN a."alignment" = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(s."id")::numeric) * 100.0 AS good_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
LEFT JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(p."id")::numeric) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE s."height_cm" BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT
    
    (SUM(CASE WHEN c."colour" = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(g."gender")) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
JOIN "colour" c ON s."skin_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female';

SELECT
    
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a."alignment" = 'Bad')::numeric
     / NULLIF(COUNT(s."id"), 0)) * 100 AS bad_percentage,
    
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a."alignment" = 'Bad' AND p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics') AS bad_marvel_count
FROM "superhero" s
LEFT JOIN "alignment" a ON a."id" = s."alignment_id"
LEFT JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id";

SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" ec ON s."eye_colour_id" = ec."id"
JOIN "colour" hc ON s."hair_colour_id" = hc."id"
WHERE ec."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND hc."colour" = 'Blond';

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics') AS dc_count,       
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics') AS marvel_count, 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics')
      - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference 
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END)
    - COUNT(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 END) AS "difference"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')

SELECT
    s."superhero_name",
    ec."colour" AS eye_colour,
    hc."colour" AS hair_colour,
    sc."colour" AS skin_colour
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" ec ON ec."id" = s."eye_colour_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" hc ON hc."id" = s."hair_colour_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" sc ON sc."id" = s."skin_colour_id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female'
  AND p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT
    
    (SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(s."id")::numeric) * 100.0 AS female_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
LEFT JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'George Lucas';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c."id" = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c."id" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
LEFT JOIN "colour" c ON s."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE s."weight_kg" = 0 OR s."weight_kg" IS NULL;

SELECT
    sh."superhero_name",
    p."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero" sh
JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = sh."publisher_id"
WHERE sh."eye_colour_id" = sh."hair_colour_id"
  AND sh."hair_colour_id" = sh."skin_colour_id"
  AND sh."eye_colour_id" IS NOT NULL
  AND sh."hair_colour_id" IS NOT NULL
  AND sh."skin_colour_id" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    e."expense_description",
    e."expense_date",
    e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
WHERE LOWER(e."expense_description") LIKE '%poster%'
  AND e."expense_date"::date = DATE '2019-09-04';

SELECT SUM(b."amount") AS total_budget_amount
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE e."event_name" = 'September Speaker';

SELECT DISTINCT
    e."event_name",
    e."location"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b
    ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."remaining" > 0;

SELECT
    b."category",      
    b."amount"         
FROM "budget" AS b
JOIN "event" AS e
    ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE e."event_name" = 'January Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."member_id") AS member_count
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" = 'Physics Teaching';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "income" i ON i."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE i."amount" > 40;

SELECT DISTINCT
    a."link_to_event"  
FROM "attendance" a
JOIN "expense" e
    ON e."link_to_member" = a."link_to_member"
WHERE e."cost" > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT mj."major_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE m."position" = 'Vice President';

SELECT z."city"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "zip_code" z ON m."zip" = z."zip_code"
WHERE m."first_name" = 'Garrett'
  AND m."last_name" = 'Gerke';

SELECT DISTINCT m."last_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" = 'Law and Constitutional Studies';

SELECT
    m."first_name" || ' ' || m."last_name" AS "full_name",
    i."source" AS "income_source"
FROM "income" i
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = i."link_to_member"
WHERE i."amount" = (
    
    SELECT MAX("amount") FROM "income"
);

SELECT
    m."last_name",
    mj."department",
    mj."college"
FROM "member" AS m
JOIN "major" AS mj
    ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" = 'Environmental Engineering';

SELECT
    m."first_name" || ' ' || m."last_name" AS full_name,
    SUM(e."cost") AS total_spent
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
GROUP BY m."member_id", m."first_name", m."last_name"
ORDER BY total_spent DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Parking'
  AND b."spent" < (
    SELECT SUM(b2."spent") / COUNT(DISTINCT e2."event_id")
    FROM "budget" b2
    JOIN "event" e2 ON e2."event_id" = b2."link_to_event"
    WHERE b2."category" = 'Parking'
  )
GROUP BY e."event_name";

SELECT m."phone"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE LOWER(mj."major_name") = 'business'
  AND LOWER(mj."college") = 'college of agriculture and applied sciences';

SELECT DISTINCT
    zc."city",
    zc."state"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj
    ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
JOIN "zip_code" zc
    ON m."zip" = zc."zip_code"
WHERE LOWER(mj."department") = LOWER('Electrical and Computer Engineering Department')
  AND LOWER(m."position") = LOWER('Member');

SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE LOWER(e."type") <> 'fundraiser'
GROUP BY e."event_id", e."event_name"
HAVING COUNT(a."link_to_member") > 20;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    mj."major_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e
    ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
LEFT JOIN "major" mj
    ON mj."major_id" = m."link_to_major"
WHERE e."cost" > 100
ORDER BY m."last_name", m."first_name";

SELECT
    
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(e."event_date", 1, 4) = '2019' THEN b."spent" END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(e."event_date", 1, 4) = '2020' THEN b."spent" END), 0) AS spent_difference
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE e."event_name" = 'Student_Club'
  AND SUBSTRING(e."event_date", 1, 4) IN ('2019', '2020');

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."member_id",
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    e."event_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a
    ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "event" e
    ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
WHERE m."first_name" = 'Maya'
  AND m."last_name" = 'Mclean'
  AND e."event_name" = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT
    e."expense_description",
    e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
JOIN "event" ev ON b."link_to_event" = ev."event_id"
WHERE ev."event_name" = 'September Speaker'
  AND e."expense_description" = 'Posters';

SELECT DISTINCT m."last_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "event" e ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
WHERE m."position" = 'Member'
  AND e."event_name" = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT AVG(e."cost") AS average_cost
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE m."first_name" = 'Elijah'
  AND m."last_name" = 'Allen'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e."expense_date") IN (9, 10);

SELECT
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END) AS yearly_kickoff_amount,
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'October Meeting' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END) AS october_meeting_amount,
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END)::numeric
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'October Meeting' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement'
  AND e."event_name" IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting');

SELECT DISTINCT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = a."link_to_member"
WHERE e."type" = 'Social'
  AND m."position" = 'Vice President'
  AND m."link_to_major" IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "event" e2
    WHERE e2."location" = '900 E. Washington St.'
      AND e2."event_id" = e."event_id"
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."member_id",
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    a."link_to_event"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e
    ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "attendance" a
    ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(e."approved")) = 'true'
  AND e."expense_date" BETWEEN DATE '2019-01-10' AND DATE '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT
    e."event_name",
    e."event_date"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "expense" ex ON ex."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE LOWER(ex."expense_description") = 'pizza'
  AND ex."cost" > 50
  AND ex."cost" < 100;

WITH member_events AS (
    
    SELECT
        e."link_to_member" AS member_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b."link_to_event") AS event_count
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    WHERE e."link_to_member" IS NOT NULL
      AND b."link_to_event" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e."link_to_member"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b."link_to_event") > 1
),
member_totals AS (
    
    SELECT
        e."link_to_member" AS member_id,
        SUM(e."cost") AS total_cost
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN member_events me ON e."link_to_member" = me.member_id
    GROUP BY e."link_to_member"
)

SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    mt.total_cost
FROM member_totals mt
JOIN "member" m ON mt.member_id = m."member_id"
ORDER BY mt.total_cost DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."first_name" || ' ' || m."last_name" AS full_name,
    m."phone" AS contact_number
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE e."cost" > (
    SELECT AVG(e2."cost")
    FROM "expense" e2
);

SELECT
    m."first_name" || ' ' || m."last_name" AS "full_name",
    e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE e."expense_description" = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies';

SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    i."amount"
FROM "income" i
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = i."link_to_member"
WHERE i."date_received" = TO_DATE('9/9/2019', 'MM/DD/YYYY');
